memory_candidates.insight: A Prop-valued consistency bundle whose fields are shaped to mirror the target structure's fields field-for-field makes the bridging theorem a citation rather than a proof: cons_localRun is 20 lines for a four-field target because each field is either a stored Bool equation read through the trace definition, or an exact application of a previously proved theorem whose statement was already written in the trace's unfolded form.

A non-vacuity fixture is worth more when it imports and exercises the landed declarations than when it re-spells them inline, even at the cost of an extra import edge the aggregator does not yet provide: the re-spelled form cannot go red when the real definition changes.

Elaborating a whole new section in a scratch file via 'lake env lean' against the already-built .olean, before touching the real module, let three consecutive phases each edit their target module exactly once. The cost is one extra elaboration; the saving is the edit-build-fix cycle on a module whose scoped build is 80 seconds.
